description: Retrieve the current user's MyFitnessPal profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the user_profile object.

description: Retrieve the scenario-specific user profile document served verbatim.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the scenario user profile document.

description: Update editable fields on the current user's profile.

display_name.description: Optional new display name for the user.

current_weight_lbs.description: Optional new current weight in pounds.

goal_weight_lbs.description: Optional new goal weight in pounds.

weekly_weight_goal_lbs.description: Optional new weekly weight change goal in pounds.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the updated user_profile object.

description: Retrieve the user's nutrition and weight goals.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and a goals object with calorie, macro, nutrient, and weight goals.

description: Update the user's calorie, macro, and weight goals.

daily_calorie_goal.description: Optional new daily calorie goal; also updates the calories nutrient goal.

macro_goals.description: Optional macro goal percentages (carbs_pct, fat_pct, protein_pct) to merge in.

goal_weight_lbs.description: Optional new goal weight in pounds.

weekly_weight_goal_lbs.description: Optional new weekly weight change goal in pounds.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the updated goals object.

description: Search the food database by name or brand with pagination.

q.description: Optional query string matched against food name and brand; all foods when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of food objects.

description: Get a single food item by its id.

food_id.description: The unique id of the food.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the food object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a day's food diary, optionally filtered by meal.

meal.description: Optional meal name to filter by (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the date, meals grouped by slot, and computed totals.

description: Get food diary entries across a date range grouped by day.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds start_date, end_date, count, and a results list of per-day diary objects.

description: Add a food item to the diary for a given date and meal.

meal.description: The meal slot (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks) (required).

food_id.description: The id of the food to log (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the created diary_entry with computed nutrition; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update an existing diary entry's servings and/or meal.

entry_id.description: The id of the diary entry to update.

servings.description: Optional new servings; recomputes nutrition when provided.

meal.description: Optional new meal slot for the entry.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the updated diary_entry; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a diary entry by id.

entry_id.description: The id of the diary entry to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field, deleted flag, and the entry_id; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get nutrition totals, goals, and remaining amounts for a single day.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the date, totals, goal, and remaining nutrient amounts.

description: Get a 7-day nutrition summary ending on the given date.

end_date.description: The last day of the week in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds start_date, end_date, averages, and per-day details; on failure (bad date), output contains an error message.

description: Get calorie and macro progress over a recent number of days.

days.description: Number of days of history to include (default 30).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds period_days, calorie_goal, and a results list of daily calorie and macro data.

description: List available exercise types with optional category filter and pagination.

category.description: Optional category to filter by (e.g. cardio, strength).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of exercise type objects.

description: Get a single exercise type by its id.

exercise_type_id.description: The unique id of the exercise type.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the exercise_type object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List logged exercises, optionally filtered by date range, with pagination.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of logged exercises sorted by date descending.

description: Get a single logged exercise by its id.

exercise_id.description: The unique id of the logged exercise.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the exercise object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Log an exercise session for the user.

date.description: The date of the exercise in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (required).

exercise_type_id.description: The id of the exercise type performed (required).

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the exercise in minutes (required).

notes.description: Optional notes about the exercise session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the created exercise object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List weight log entries sorted by date descending, with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds count, total, offset, limit, and a results list of weight entries.

description: Get a single weight log entry by its id.

weight_id.description: The unique id of the weight entry.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the weight_entry object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a weight log entry for the user.

date.description: The date of the weigh-in in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the created weight_entry object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the water intake entry for a given date.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the water object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a water intake entry for a given date.

cups.description: Number of cups of water consumed (required).

notes.description: Optional notes about the water intake.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the created water object; on failure (already exists or missing field), output contains an error message.

description: Update the water intake entry for a given date.

date.description: The date of the water entry in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

cups.description: Optional new number of cups consumed.

notes.description: Optional new notes about the water intake.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a type field and the updated water object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
